description: Links and buttons by what they do when activated, with the network held. Links that open a dialog or show a panel without navigating act as buttons; a button that goes to another page acts as a link (likely). Not reported: a link whose router changes the address (pushState), a button that opens a dialog, a submit button of a search form (never activated), a button that navigates with the value of a field (a search sent by script), a same-page link, a hash route, a button that adds to the cart, a plain link.
